behaviors.behavior: AC1: where the predicate holds, promotion happens without operator interaction, with its evidence named
behaviors.evidence: test_all_green_promotes_with_full_observed_layer_set + test_promotes_a_green_fr_and_rewrites_spec_manifest_and_ledger (pytest); REAL run against this repo promoted 9/32 FRs, each ledger entry naming evidence_test_ids + evidence_source_commit, re-verified green against the real traceability_manifest_gate.py CI gate

behaviors.behavior: AC2: no batch promotion path exists
behaviors.evidence: test_evaluate_manifest_partitions_decisions (each FR decided independently, no sweep/--all flag exists in promote_fr_layers.py's argparse surface); code review confirms no batch code path

behaviors.behavior: AC3: only undecidable cases escalate, each naming which one
behaviors.evidence: test_no_observable_layer_escalates, test_missing_evidence_is_absent_not_fail_escalates, test_ledger_demotion_contradiction_escalates, test_failing_evidence_skips_not_green_no_escalation (decidable, not an escalation); REAL run's committed layer_promotion_escalation.json names all 23 escalated FRs + reason codes

behaviors.behavior: AC4: the run cannot author its own promotion approval
behaviors.evidence: test_escalates_and_hands_back_when_evidence_is_absent (no ack file ever written by the run itself), test_a_stale_ack_from_a_different_escalation_set_does_not_clear_the_stop, test_a_matching_operator_ack_clears_the_stop_on_rerun

behaviors.behavior: A regen #2 failure rolls back spec.md instead of leaving a half-promoted working tree (external code review finding, GLM high)
behaviors.evidence: test_a_regen_2_failure_rolls_back_spec_md_instead_of_leaving_it_half_promoted (monkeypatched flaky regen, asserts byte-identical spec.md + no manifest/ledger written)

behaviors.behavior: A stale (over-age) vitest report is rejected rather than trusted as fresh (external code review finding, openai high)
An unsafe run_id (path traversal) is rejected before touching any output path (external code review finding, openai medium)
A quarantined manifest-side test binding never counts as observed coverage (external plan review finding, GLM/openai)
A non-dict evidence entry fails closed as absent evidence, never crashes (external code review finding, GLM low)
An unrecognized layer name is named in the escalation detail, not silently dropped (external code review finding, GLM low)
A removed FR is named in the run's own removed_fr_ids output, not silently invisible (external code review finding, GLM low)

surface_verification.justification: No frontend file changed (detect_frontend_changes.py --cwd . --since <merge-base>: has_frontend_changes:false, files:[]); this iterate is CI/compliance tooling (scripts/ci/*.py) plus spec.md metadata edits, no client/server route/component/schema change.
